title: The Mystery of the Gospel Revealed, Prayer for Spiritual Strength

questions.question: Paul describes himself as a ____ of Christ Jesus on behalf of the Gentiles.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:1 (ESV): "For this reason I, Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles—"

questions.question: Assuming that you have heard of the stewardship of God's ____ that was given to me for you,
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:2 (ESV): "assuming that you have heard of the stewardship of God's grace that was given to me for you,"

questions.question: How was the mystery made known to Paul?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:3 (ESV): "how the mystery was made known to me by revelation, as I have written briefly."

questions.question: Which is not part of the mystery of Christ regarding the Gentiles as stated in verse 6? The Gentiles are ____, members of the same body, and partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:6 (ESV): "This mystery is that the Gentiles are fellow heirs, members of the same body, and partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel." Kings and priests is not listed here.

questions.question: Of this gospel Paul was made a minister according to the gift of God's grace, which was given him by the working of his ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:7 (ESV): "Of this gospel I was made a minister according to the gift of God's grace, which was given me by the working of his power."

questions.question: Though Paul considers himself the very least of all the saints, this grace was given to him to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable ____ of Christ.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:8 (ESV): "To me, though I am the very least of all the saints, this grace was given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,"

questions.question: God's intent was that through the church the manifold ____ of God might now be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly places.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:10 (ESV): "so that through the church the manifold wisdom of God might now be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly places."

questions.question: In Christ Jesus our Lord we have boldness and access with ____ through our faith in him.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:12 (ESV): "in whom we have boldness and access with confidence through our faith in him."

questions.question: Paul asks them not to lose heart over what?
options: What he is suffering for them
questions.correctAnswer: What he is suffering for them
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:13 (ESV): "So I ask you not to lose heart over what I am suffering for you, which is your glory."

questions.question: For this reason Paul bows his knees before the ____, from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:14-15 (ESV): "For this reason I bow my knees before the Father, from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,"

questions.question: He prays that God may grant them to be strengthened with power through his Spirit in their ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:16 (ESV): "that according to the riches of his glory he may grant you to be strengthened with power through his Spirit in your inner being,"

questions.question: So that Christ may dwell in your ____ through faith.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:17 (ESV): "so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith—that you, being rooted and grounded in love,"

questions.question: Paul prays that they, being rooted and grounded in love, may have strength to comprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and ____ and ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:18 (ESV): "may have strength to comprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth,"

questions.question: And to know the ____ of Christ that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:19 (ESV): "and to know the love of Christ that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God."

questions.question: Now to him who is able to do far more abundantly than all that we ask or think, according to the ____ at work within us...
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:20 (ESV): "Now to him who is able to do far more abundantly than all that we ask or think, according to the power at work within us,"

key_verse_text: Now to him who is able to do far more abundantly than all that we ask or think, according to the power at work within us, to him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
